from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
from pathlib import Path
import json
key=Path('/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key').read_text().strip()
gi=GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', key=key)
t=gi.tools.show_tool('toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/goeckslab/phykit_metrics/phykit_metrics/0.2.0+galaxy0', io_details=True)
Path('codex_output/phykit_tool.json').write_text(json.dumps(t, indent=2))

def walk_inputs(inputs, path=''):
    for inp in inputs:
        typ=inp.get('type')
        name=inp.get('name')
        print(path+name, typ, 'label=', inp.get('label'), 'value=', inp.get('value'))
        if typ=='conditional':
            print(' test', inp.get('test_param',{}).get('name'), inp.get('test_param',{}).get('options'))
            for case in inp.get('cases',[]):
                print(' CASE', path+name, '=', case.get('value'))
                walk_inputs(case.get('inputs',[]), path+name+'.'+case.get('value')+'.')
        elif typ=='repeat':
            walk_inputs(inp.get('inputs',[]), path+name+'[].')

# Print operation options and only treeness/evolutionary cases summaries
op=t['inputs'][0]
print('operation test options:')
print(op['test_param']['options'])
for case in op['cases']:
    if 'treeness' in case['value'] or case['value'] in ['evolutionary_rate','treeness','treeness_rcv','treeness_over_rcv']:
        print('\\n=== OP CASE', case['value'], '===')
        walk_inputs(case['inputs'])
print('\\noutputs')
print(json.dumps(t.get('outputs'), indent=2)[:6000])
PY"
